The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. The Tax Information Reporting and Withholding Advisory Manager will be an integral part of the Coinbase tax team. The role sits at the intersection of tax advisory, product development, and operational execution, helping Coinbase translate complex U.S. and global tax requirements into scalable processes and systems. This role focuses on strong advisory judgment and practical experience applying information reporting and withholding rules in fast-moving business environments. 

The Coinbase tax team ensures full compliance with tax obligations across all jurisdictions in which Coinbase operates, including building world-class tax protocols for digital asset transactions. We are passionate about tax and crypto, and we are seeking a candidate with a similar passion and collaborative mindset to join our team.
 
What you'll do:
  • Own end-to-end execution of key information reporting and withholding workstreams, including reporting readiness, withholding calculations, reconciliations, remittance support, and operational issue resolution.
  • Translate tax laws, regulations, and internal policy positions into clear business requirements, logic, and data specifications for technical and operational teams.
  • Review product and process changes to identify tax impacts, define data capture needs, and ensure compliance requirements are addressed early in the development lifecycle.
  • Partner with Tax, Product, Engineering, Operations, CX, and Finance to implement scalable processes supporting U.S. and global compliance.
  • Lead the design and execution of user acceptance testing for tax-related features, workflows, and reporting outputs.
  • Support tax audits, notices, and regulatory inquiries through timely data gathering, reconciliation, and documentation.

Required Skills and Experience:
  • 8+ years of experience in information reporting and withholding within a bank, broker-dealer, fintech, technology company, Big 4, or similar advisory environment.
  • Deep working knowledge of U.S. information reporting and withholding regimes (Forms 1099, 1042-S, 1099-DA, backup withholding, NRA withholding) with familiarity with global regimes such as CRS and CARF.
  • Proven ability to draft business requirements, translate tax rules into implementable logic, and partner with engineering teams to operationalize compliance.
  • Advisory experience from a law firm, Big 4, accounting firm, or in-house tax function, with the ability to explain complex tax requirements clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

descriptions.job-0fp17ht:
At Breeze, we're building the AI-powered infrastructure layer for global commerce, making it radically simpler for businesses to sell, get paid, and operate across markets.

We go far beyond traditional payment processing. Breeze combines global payments, AI, stablecoins, and a Merchant of Record-like model to take on the complexity businesses typically manage themselves, including compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.

Our goal is simple: let businesses focus on building and selling great products while Breeze handles the complexity behind getting paid.

Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, Breeze is a successful, rapidly growing, and exceptionally well-capitalized company. We have the runway to think long term while remaining early enough that every person joining today can have a meaningful impact on what we build.

We are hiring a Technical Account Manager, Singapore!

As our Technical Account Manager, you'll be the owner of our relationship with a portfolio of key merchants, helping them integrate with Breeze, go live smoothly, and get lasting value from our payment solutions. You'll combine the commercial instincts of an Account Manager with the technical depth to debug an integration, read an API log, and talk to a merchant's engineering team as a peer. Reporting to our Director of Sales, APAC.

You'll work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Risk and Compliance to make sure merchants adopt Breeze quickly, stay healthy in production, and grow with us. As one of the first technical account management hires in Singapore, you'll help build the function from the ground up.

We're looking for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, wants meaningful ownership, and is excited to build rather than simply maintain.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical and commercial success of a portfolio of key merchant accounts, driving adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • Lead merchant integrations and go-lives end to end, from technical scoping and API, webhook, and checkout integration guidance to sandbox testing and launch readiness.
  • Act as the primary technical contact for merchant engineering teams: answer integration questions, review implementations, and advise on best practices.
  • Troubleshoot production issues such as payment failures, declines, webhook delivery problems, settlement and reconciliation discrepancies, and chargebacks. Analyze logs, API requests and responses, and transaction data to find root causes.
  • Escalate to Engineering with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and merchant impact, and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Own communication with affected merchants during incidents and degradations, working with Engineering and Operations to keep updates clear, timely, and accurate.
  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers on technical scoping and a smooth handoff of new merchants into account management.
  • Run strategic account planning, Quarterly Business Reviews, and technical product training, including regular integration health reviews covering success and error rates, latency, and feature adoption.
  • Create and maintain integration guides, runbooks, and merchant-facing FAQs, and use SQL, scripts, and dashboards to monitor merchant health.
  • Build, improve, and maintain CRM systems, client health metrics, and standardized reporting workflows.
  • Track and report on merchant churn rate, revenue growth and retention, client satisfaction, integration health, and adoption of new Breeze features.
  • Represent the technical voice of the customer internally: turn merchant feedback and integration friction into clear product and engineering requirements, and identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Solutions or Sales Engineering, Technical Support Engineering, or a similar technical client-facing role, preferably within Payments or FinTech.
  • Strong working knowledge of payments, including authorization, capture, refunds, chargebacks and disputes, settlement and reconciliation, and how risk, fraud, and compliance shape payment flows.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs and integrations: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, idempotency, error handling, and sandbox testing, using tools such as Postman, cURL, and browser developer tools.
  • Comfortable reading logs, request and response payloads, and code, and writing basic scripts (Python or JavaScript) and SQL queries to investigate issues and analyze transaction data.
  • Able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and executives, and to earn the trust of merchant engineering teams.
  • Experience working in scale-up and high-growth environments, and growing strategic client relationships to drive revenue.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with global Sales, Product, Engineering, and Risk and Compliance teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple high-priority merchant accounts, internal stakeholders from executive level down, and complex client issues and incidents effectively.
  • A proactive, results-oriented mindset with strong debugging instincts and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments without an established playbook.
  • A builder mentality with a strong bias toward action.
  • Excited to use AI and automation to work smarter and rethink existing processes.
  • Comfortable getting into the details and doing the work, regardless of seniority.
  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, Singapore.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.
  • Experience with crypto, stablecoin, cross-border, or multi-currency payment products.
  • Familiarity with Merchant of Record, PSP, or acquiring models and card network rules.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools, BI or reporting dashboards, and client health scoring tools.
  • Prior experience in a Solutions Engineering or Forward Deployed Engineering role.
  • Fluency in Mandarin or other APAC languages [to confirm].

Why Breeze

  • More than payments: We're building an intelligent infrastructure layer across payments, compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.
  • AI from the ground up: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate.
  • Successful and still early: We have meaningful traction and strong financial foundations while remaining early enough for new hires to have outsized impact.
  • Built for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.
  • Real ownership: Lean teams, few layers, direct access to decision-makers, and the autonomy to make things happen.
  • Hard problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce.
  • Exceptional team: Work with ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly and care deeply about what they build.
  • Room to grow: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.

How We Work

  • Act Now, Improve Later: Ship something real today. Move fast, learn from what happens, and make it better.
  • Disagree and Commit: Debate hard before a decision. Once it's made, commit fully and make the outcome right.
  • Customers First: When in doubt, start with what's most painful for the customer.
  • Own It, End to End: Don't wait to be asked. If you see a problem, take responsibility for solving it.
  • Default to Public: Share context openly so the whole team can move faster and learn from each other.
  • High Standards, Genuine Warmth: Hold the bar high and treat people well. Be direct, rigorous, kind, and low ego.
  • Outcomes Over Activity: We care about what ships, what works, and what moves the needle, not how busy you look.
  • AI Forward, Always Learning: Experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, share what works, and continuously rethink how you can work smarter.

Compensation Philosophy

We believe compensation should be fair, competitive, consistent, and transparent. We benchmark compensation against the market and establish thoughtful bands for each role, with compensation reflecting experience, skills, location, role scope, and expected impact. We don't believe pay should primarily depend on how aggressively someone negotiates. Eligible employees receive meaningful equity, so the people building Breeze can participate in the long-term value they help create.

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical allowance: An annual allowance, prorated based on your start date, to support eligible health and wellness expenses, including health screenings, dental and vision care, insurance premiums, and eligible expenses for direct family members.
  • Corporate medical insurance: Medical coverage for full-time employees in our Singapore office, including cashless GP visits at panel clinics, specialist outpatient care with GP referral, and teleconsultations.
  • Gym & wellness: A monthly subsidy toward eligible fitness and wellness memberships, classes, and activities.
  • Productivity budget: An annual budget, prorated based on your start date, for professional development, productivity tools, books, courses, and eligible home-office improvements.
  • Equity: Meaningful ownership in the company you're helping build.
  • Equipment: A new MacBook Air and whatever else you need to do your best work.
  • Annual global offsite: We bring the global Breeze team together every year. Previous destinations include Bali and Singapore, with Japan coming next.

Benefits, allowances, and reimbursements are subject to applicable eligibility requirements, taxes, and statutory contributions. Benefits are not contractual and may be amended from time to time.

Location / Working Model

This role is in office and based in Singapore.

At Breeze, we value in-person collaboration and connection. As a lean and fast-moving startup, physical presence in the office is key to fostering teamwork and productivity, and helps us stay agile and aligned. Employees based in our Singapore office are expected to work on-site five days per week, and remote work is not available for full-time employees in our Singapore office.

In-office expectations may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process.

Our approach is designed to support meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making while providing flexibility where applicable. We believe this structure enables strong execution, close collaboration, and effective teamwork across our global office

Why Join Breeze

  • Make an outsized impact: We're successful and still early, with meaningful traction and strong financial foundations. Lean teams, few layers, and direct access to decision-makers mean you'll have real ownership and the autonomy to make things happen.
  • Solve hard, meaningful problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce as we build an intelligent infrastructure layer that goes far beyond payments.
  • Build AI-first: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate. You'll experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, and continuously rethink how to work smarter.
  • Work with an exceptional team: Join ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly, hold a high bar, and care deeply about what they build.
  • Grow with Breeze: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.
  • Build for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our New York City, NY office follow a hybrid work model and are expected to work from the office three days per week. Employees based in our Singapore office are expected to work on-site five days per week.

In-office expectations may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process.

Our approach is designed to support meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making while providing flexibility where applicable. We believe this structure enables strong execution, close collaboration, and effective teamwork across our global offices.

Come Build With Us!

We offer a rare combination: the ownership and speed of an early-stage company with the traction, backing, and financial foundations of a successful business.

We're building at the convergence of AI, payments, stablecoins, financial infrastructure, and global commerce. The opportunity is much bigger than building another payment processor.

We're building the intelligent infrastructure layer for global commerce, and there's still an enormous amount left to build.

If you want meaningful ownership, hard problems, exceptional teammates, and the opportunity to help define what comes next, we'd love to hear from you!

About us

Machines will make decisions, move value, and coordinate on behalf of organizations, instantly, autonomously, and at unprecedented scale. But the systems that govern today’s economy weren’t designed for that world. Turnkey is building the infrastructure for this future: programmable guardrails that enable autonomy without sacrificing control.

Founded by the team that scaled Coinbase Custody to $100M+ in ARR and secured more than $100B in crypto assets, we’ve built systems trusted to move and protect billions in value.

Our mission is to help the world operate an economy on autopilot, safely. We’re low-ego, high-agency, and deeply technical. Our team brings expertise in cryptography, security, and systems, and believes great infrastructure is invisible. We’re building the trustless, programmable foundation for the autonomous economy.

The role

We're hiring a Startup Account Executive who thrives at the intersection of developers, startups, and sales. This is a developer-focused, quota-carrying role centered on building relationships with technical founders, helping startups discover and build with Turnkey, and converting developer adoption into commercial relationships.

You'll spend your time breaking down the doors at emerging startups, engaging developer communities, attending hackathons and industry events, helping teams evaluate our APIs and SDKs, and guiding startups from initial experimentation through production and paid adoption. You'll also help shape Turnkey's developer-led startup sales motion as we scale.

What you’ll do

  • Build and manage a pipeline of startup prospects, with a strong focus on self-sourced outbound and targeted account research.
  • Run the full sales cycle, from first outreach and discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and close.
  • Lead useful conversations with founders, product and engineering leaders, and other stakeholders. Understand their roadmap, use cases, buying process, and constraints.
  • Actively participate in developer communities, hackathons, technical meetups, conferences, and startup events. Build relationships with developers, founders, and ecosystem partners to drive awareness, adoption, and pipeline.
  • Develop hands-on expertise with Turnkey's APIs, SDKs, and infrastructure. Run technical demos, answer developer questions, and help startups understand how to integrate Turnkey into their applications.
  • Coordinate product, engineering, and GTM partners when prospects need deeper technical or commercial support.
  • Help developers move from initial exploration to building and deploying with Turnkey. Identify friction in the developer journey and collaborate with product, engineering, and solutions to improve technical resources, demos, and onboarding.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline records, next steps, and forecasts in Attio. Participate in regular pipeline reviews with the revenue team.
  • Meet the role’s quota and track the activity and conversion measures that support it, including pipeline creation, opportunity progress, and closed revenue.
  • Build a repeatable startup sales motion. Test messaging and approaches, share what works, and bring structured market and customer feedback to GTM leadership.
  • Set up a clear handoff to the appropriate team after close and stay engaged to support a strong start for the customer.

What we’re looking for

  • 1 - 3 years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, with evidence that you can create and close new business. Experience selling to startups, developers/founders, or technical buyers is a plus.
  • Comfort owning the full sales cycle rather than relying on a separate team for prospecting or closing.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can tailor a clear message to the person you’re speaking with.
  • Curiosity about crypto, payments, fintech, developer products, or technical infrastructure.
  • The ability to learn complex products and explain them without oversimplifying what matters.
  • Good judgment in discovery: you ask direct questions, listen closely, and qualify opportunities honestly.
  • Strong organization and follow-through across multiple opportunities and stakeholders.
  • Resilience, competitiveness, and a bias for action. You can make progress when the playbook is still being built.
  • A collaborative approach and comfort working with founders, senior leaders, and technical teams.

Why join us

  • Work with a founding team that has deep experience building trusted financial infrastructure.
  • Own a real quota and a complete sales cycle while helping shape a focused startup sales motion.
  • Work at the intersection of fintech, payments, crypto, AI, and global commerce.
  • Bring customer insight directly to product and GTM leadership.
  • Join a collaborative, fast-moving team that values low ego and high agency.

What we offer

  • Full benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA/FSA, and 401(k)
  • Paid parental leave
  • Unlimited PTO
  • $3,000 per year for learning and development, including conferences and education
  • Multiple team offsites per year
  • Lunch stipend
Compensation range
$77,000—$125,000 USD

descriptions.job-0wynx81:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward’s Payments & Blockchain team builds the capabilities that move money into and out of its products, connecting banking partners, payment providers and local rails for millions of users.


We’re building a peer-to-peer marketplace for Asia-Pacific that lets users buy and sell digital assets directly with each other using familiar local payment methods. Payward will provide the marketplace infrastructure, merchant network, escrow, transaction management, and trust and safety capabilities.


We’re looking for an experienced product leader who has launched crypto P2P in APAC and can turn that expertise into a shared platform serving multiple Payward products.

The opportunity

  • Strategy and market expansion: Set the P2P vision, business objectives and roadmap. Prioritize markets, customer segments and payment methods based on demand, competitive conditions, economics and regulatory requirements.

  • Merchant network and liquidity: Develop the merchant acquisition, onboarding, incentives and retention strategy. Work with commercial and local teams to build dependable liquidity, competitive pricing and coverage across relevant payment methods.

  • Marketplace economics: Define fee structures and incentive programs. Set commercial targets and improve revenue, transaction costs and contribution margin with finance and commercial partners.

  • Core P2P capabilities: Lead product development across matching, escrow, order management, payment confirmation, transaction limits, merchant controls and dispute handling.

  • Platform adoption: Build reusable capabilities and integration requirements that allow multiple Payward products to offer P2P. Make the platform straightforward to integrate, operate and extend into new markets.

  • Buyer, seller and merchant requirements: Define transaction workflows, exception handling and acceptance criteria. Bring customer research and marketplace expertise into interface decisions, and use transaction data to identify friction and improve completion.

  • Trust and marketplace integrity: Partner with risk, compliance, legal and operations to build merchant verification, fraud prevention, dispute resolution and appeals into the product from the outset.

  • Launch and operating performance: Lead cross-functional launch planning and establish the processes needed to run each market. Track liquidity, order completion, time to trade, repeat usage, dispute rates, fraud losses and platform reliability.

  • Product leadership: Align senior stakeholders around priorities and tradeoffs, work closely with engineering on system capabilities, and develop product talent as the platform scales. Apply proven P2P playbooks and move quickly from decisions to live transactions.

What you bring

  • A demonstrated record of launching and scaling a crypto P2P marketplace in APAC, ideally including a launch from zero.

  • Senior product leadership experience with responsibility for strategy, roadmaps and measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Deep understanding of merchant operations, two-sided liquidity, pricing, incentives and the economics of P2P trading.

  • Practical knowledge of APAC payment methods, local banking and wallet ecosystems, and how customer behavior differs across markets.

  • Experience building shared platform capabilities used by multiple products, channels or external partners.

  • Strong judgment about fraud, payment verification, transaction disputes and the operational realities of running a financial marketplace.

  • Technical fluency across APIs, transaction lifecycles, payment integrations and reliable financial systems.

  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead through partnerships with engineering, interface product teams, operations, risk and commercial teams.

Nice to haves

  • Experience expanding P2P across several APAC markets.

  • Experience with stablecoins and local fiat on/off-ramps.

  • Experience building and leading product teams.

  • Fluency in one or more APAC languages.

descriptions.job-01nyqsx:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Customer Care Product team’s mission is to build the product experiences, automation, and human-assisted touchpoints that support our customers at every stage of their financial journey. We design the client-facing tools, scheduling flows, and expert consultation routing that power our new premium financial offerings. Our team operates at a fast pace, collaborating closely with central marketing, the Concierge team, and growth marketing to deliver a seamless customer experience. We prioritize ethical execution and compliance while striving to democratize premium services for our users.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will lead the GTM strategy and prospect acquisition for our new premium financial offering. In this role, you will design and stand up a B2B-hybrid marketing motion to bring in prospects who are not yet Robinhood customers. You will personally build and execute outbound channels like LinkedIn, email, and outreach, while directing central marketing and Concierge teams for other channels. By implementing a CRM-integrated martech stack, you will orchestrate conversion paths and build marketing attribution to optimize CAC:LTV. This is an exciting opportunity to build a high-priority marketing infrastructure from scratch and make a major business impact!

This role is based in our New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Net-new prospect funnel: Personally build and run outbound marketing—including LinkedIn, email, and outreach—to reach a high-net-worth and mass-affluent audience outside our current customer base.
  • Conversion path orchestration: Own both the free expert consultation and self-serve signup paths. Partner with product to lead qualification and routing to expert calendars, nurture no-shows and not-yet-ready leads, and test outreach channels.
  • Channel orchestration via central marketing and Concierge: Set the strategy and brief execution for paid, brand creative, events, and owned/lifecycle channels through the central marketing and Concierge teams.
  • Marketing stack build-out: Implement the marketing technology required to run marketing for this audience, integrating with a CRM (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Launch readiness: Drive marketing execution against a confidential internal timeline.
  • GTM partnership across departments: Partner with central marketing, Concierge, growth, product, and legal/compliance as strategy and budget finalize—understanding project timelines and key marketing outputs, triaging problems in real time, and advocating for the prospective client's needs.
  • Unit-economics ownership: Build and iterate marketing attribution and efficiency, with a primary focus on net-new client acquisition costs relative to lifetime value (CAC:LTV).

What you bring 

  • 6+ years of experience in B2B or B2B2C demand generation or growth marketing, with hands-on experience building, not just running, campaigns inside an existing stack.
  • Experience creating a marketing stack that pairs outbound channels (LinkedIn, email, outreach) with a live "book a call/demo" conversion flow (marketing automation, lead routing, scheduling, and attribution).
  • Experience marketing a sales-assisted product (such as wealth management, fintech, insurance, or B2B SaaS with a human handoff) where the funnel leads to a live conversation rather than a self-serve signup.
  • Routine use of AI across your marketing workflow, with comfort directing a hybrid workflow of human collaborators and AI tools.
  • Experience shipping outbound campaigns end-to-end, pairing creative assets and messaging with distribution channels, and experience directing other teams or agencies on channels you do not produce yourself.

Nice to have

  • Experience in wealth management, private banking, Registered Investment Advisor (RIA), or a fintech-serving high-net-worth background.
  • Experience with compliance-reviewed marketing in a regulated financial services environment.
  • Experience planning small, high-touch VIP or executive events.
  • Depth in two or more areas of product marketing, growth/demand generation, and content/brand, with the ability to operate across all three.
  • Comfort building and presenting a GTM perspective to senior leaders under an evolving timeline and confidentiality constraints.

Our team has built and operates the infrastructure connecting OKX to dozens of payment channels across global markets, giving users deposit and withdrawal options that are fast, convenient, and — most importantly — trustworthy. Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About the role

TRM is building a highly impactful, collaborative Environmental Crimes intelligence function, with one goal: disrupt the illicit actors behind wildlife trafficking and other environmental crimes, and add real friction to their ability to operate.

As our Senior or Staff Intelligence Analyst, Environmental Crimes, you will own TRM's intelligence on this category end-to-end. You will research, analyze, and publish intelligence on environmental crime networks and the crypto and financial flows behind them, combining on-chain tracing, OSINT, and off-chain data from partners into a picture that law enforcement, NGOs, and private-sector partners can act on.

You will also be the clear TRM owner for our partnership with United for Wildlife and Project Pangolin, serving a global network of partner organizations as a trusted advisor, convener, and the expert user who shapes how TRM's products serve this mission. What makes this role unique: you get to build a new intelligence category from the ground up, on the leading blockchain intelligence platform, with executive sponsorship and direct real-world impact.

The impact you will have

  • Build the environmental crimes threat picture. Research, author, and publish intelligence products (threat assessments, typology reports, trend analysis, actor profiles, network maps) on environmental crime and the illicit finance behind it, and maintain a reusable threat picture inside TRM's intelligence infrastructure.

  • Drive investigations to action. Develop and use a wide variety of intelligence sources, tools, and capabilities — on-chain, OSINT, and partner-provided off-chain data — to identify the wallets, entities, and off-ramps behind environmental crime networks. Produce structured, source-cited targeting packages that support law enforcement and partner investigations and surface disruption opportunities.

  • Own the United for Wildlife partner program. Replace fractional coverage with a managed, repeatable program across a network of 200+ partner organizations: case assistance, analysis, guidance, training, and onboarding.

  • Bring the community together. Organize virtual and in-person cross-sector, cross-border sprints and working groups aimed at real-time disruption, and collaborate with partners such as USFWS, HSI, DOJ, Interpol, UNODC, national agencies, and NGOs.

  • Be TRM's public voice on environmental crimes. Brief internal stakeholders, partners, and leadership, and represent TRM with media, at external events, and with other stakeholders to amplify our intelligence.

  • Shape the product. Act as the representative power user of TRM's mission tooling for the environmental crimes community, turning field needs into structured feedback and partnering with product teams to prototype new analysis and collaboration capabilities.

  • Scale your coverage with AI. Build reusable AI workflows for signal processing, target selection, and drafting, with human validation where it matters, so more of your time goes to high-judgment analysis and partner delivery.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in intelligence analysis, financial crime, illicit finance, blockchain intelligence, or transnational threat investigations.

  • Domain knowledge of wildlife trafficking, environmental crime, and/or transnational smuggling — or a closely adjacent illicit-trade domain, with a demonstrated ability to ramp fast.

  • Proven ability to independently run complex, multi-source investigations and produce clear, decision-ready, source-cited written intelligence for both expert and non-expert audiences.

  • Strong proficiency in OSINT methodology and tradecraft, with hands-on experience using commercial databases and investigative tools.

  • Production AI fluency: you already use AI and LLMs to accelerate research and analysis, build reusable workflows, and critically evaluate AI output — neither accept-all nor reject-all.

  • A partner- and community-facing operator: you build trust and energize a multi-organization network, and you are comfortable owning an external partner program, not only heads-down analysis.

  • Strong stakeholder communication, briefing, and facilitation skills.

  • Self-directed: you thrive in ambiguity and generate visible wins quickly in an early-stage initiative.

  • Commitment to becoming fluent in blockchain tracing and TRM's tooling. Prior crypto experience is not required; we will train you.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on blockchain or crypto tracing experience across multiple chains and obfuscation techniques (strongly preferred).

  • Experience working alongside law enforcement or NGOs in a conservation or enforcement context.

  • Experience delivering training or enablement to external partners.

  • Experience organizing events or operational working groups that bring diverse stakeholders together to drive action.

  • Regional language skills relevant to key trafficking corridors (e.g., Mandarin, Vietnamese, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese).

About the team

  • You will join TRM's Primary Intelligence organization and work day-to-day with the Environmental Crimes team, a distributed group producing finished intelligence across threat categories.

  • Environmental crime is a category TRM is investing in at the executive level, including our collaboration with United for Wildlife.

  • Mission-first, high-autonomy, execution-oriented culture with rigorous analytical standards.

  • AI-native: analysts use AI daily and build reusable methods that the whole team adopts.

Team operating rhythms

  • Distributed, not distant: a global team that collaborates across time zones with regular overlap for syncs.

  • Slack-first, async communication; @mention for timely responses.

  • Weekly 1:1s and team syncs, plus case and partner-delivery rhythms.

  • Regular engagement with external partners and cross-functional teams.

  • Required online and collaboration hours: Overlap with US, EMEA, and APAC time zones for internal syncs and partner engagement.

  • On-call responsibilities: N/A

  • Travel requirements: Up to 20%. Expect about 6 or more major trips per year for key industry and partner events (e.g., Climate Weeks) plus 2 TRM offsites.

  • Onsite requirements: None; remote, distributed role.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position

  • Within 30 days: Take ownership of an active environmental crimes case and deliver a finished, source-cited intelligence product a partner can act on.

  • Within 60 days: Deliver intelligence or training to at least one United for Wildlife partner, and ship a reusable AI workflow another analyst adopts.

  • Within 90 days: Stand up a repeatable partner-delivery play for the United for Wildlife network, publish or brief your first environmental crimes intelligence product, and hand off leads that support disruption.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

The Customer Outcomes Team (COT) is made up of cryptocurrency investigators, blockchain data experts, and enablement specialists who help transform Chainalysis data into real-world impact.

Chainalysis is seeking a customer-focused, technically strong Deployment Strategists to lead the end-to-end delivery, adoption, and ongoing success of our Data Solutions product. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, domain expertise, and customer partnership.

This individual will work directly with customers to understand their mission, design and deliver tailored solutions using Chainalysis data and products, and act as a trusted technical and domain advisor. Success in this role requires deep technical capability, an understanding of blockchain and crypto investigations, and an exceptional ability to develop strong customer relations.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of Chainalysis Services engagements, from discovery through implementation, education, and ongoing monitoring.

  • Partner directly with Financial Institution (FI) customers to understand their AML/CFT compliance and market expansion objectives and translate into data-driven monitoring solutions.

  • Design, build, and maintain custom compliance workflows, notebooks, and dashboards that allow private sector customers to identify and mitigate exposure to illicit activity.

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for Americas-based private sector customers, building trusted relationships through hands-on data expertise and industry knowledge.

  • Lead solution design discussions and technical deep dives focused on integrating Chainalysis data into existing bank infrastructure and compliance stacks.

  • Deliver briefings and presentations to both technical data teams and non-technical compliance leadership, bridging the gap between data science and regulatory expectations.

  • Collaborate closely with internal Product, Engineering, and Regulatory Affairs teams to influence the roadmap for our compliance and market expansion-centric data offerings based on customer feedback.

  • Support and mentor other Services team members by sharing best practices for navigating the unique regulatory and competitive landscape of the Americas (e.g., BSA, Travel Rule, OFAC).

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Delivered customer-facing data or analytics solutions specifically within the private sector.

  • Built insights from complex financial datasets and communicated risk-based findings to internal or external audit/compliance stakeholders.

  • Worked directly with customers in AML, KYC, financial crime, or regulatory compliance domains within the Americas region.

  • Experience navigating the compliance requirements of traditional financial institutions or high-growth FinTechs.

  • Operated successfully in fast-paced environments requiring the ability to pivot between different regulatory jurisdictions and customer risk appetites.

  • Ideally supported cryptocurrency compliance workflows, such as alert tuning, SAR filing, or sanctions screening.

Technical Skills:

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, transformation, and building automated compliance monitoring solutions.

  • Experience building notebooks and dashboards that visualize risk metrics and transaction patterns.

  • Solid understanding of data modeling and working with large-scale financial transaction data.

  • Ability to quickly develop deep expertise in Chainalysis data structures to map them to traditional banking "Know Your Transaction" (KYT) needs.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.
